label: Hand-written fixture transcript. NOT recorded from a live model run; it replays against the bundled local test shop only.
goal: Which in-stock item in the demo shop is the cheapest?

steps.text: The page lists three products. I will scroll to make sure I have seen every product before comparing prices.

arguments.result: AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX at $999.00 is the cheapest in-stock item (Intel Arc A770 at $289.00 is out of stock).
